label: EXPLORATORY ADDENDUM, DECLARED AFTER THE MAIN STUDY. Published-method benchmark inside the RC-QASyn pipeline. Re-implementations of curation principles are not the authors' code. No significance, superiority or state-of-the-art claim.
declaration_rule: Every setting below is committed before any v2 score is computed and is never changed after scoring begins. One execution; every row reported, including unavailable rows and unfavourable results.
adaptations_from_brief: Settings and outputs live in addendum/v2/ instead of configs/empirical/ and artifacts/reports/, which are protected historical paths.
Nine datasets, not ten: winequality-red-4 is unavailable (empty archive at the authorized URL; see addendum v1).
vehicle0 has no structurally complete candidate, so every curator, including the two re-implemented ones, is unavailable there; oversampler comparators still run.
Re-implemented curators select from the structurally complete 4b pool (identical to the raw 4b pool on every dataset except vehicle0), because the pipeline never trains on schema-invalid rows.

SMOTE-ENN and SMOTE-Tomek are attempted with an SMOTENC oversampling step on nominal datasets; imbalanced-learn's cleaning step requires numeric input, so a library error is recorded as unavailable. Borderline-SMOTE and ADASYN have no nominal path in imbalanced-learn 0.14.2 and are declared unavailable on nominal datasets.
The literature sanity check adds the three other datasets present in the same source table (yeast3, yeast4, abalone9-18) and that table's ADASYN, SMOTEENN and SMOTE-TOMEK columns, as context only.

new.budget_rule: b = min(70, max(30, round(0.5 * n_train_minority))) per split (addendum v1 rule)

pools.construction: existing rcqasyn.empirical.generation.generate(train, spec, generator, 4b, split_seed) on make_split(loaded, split_seed) TRAIN, minority only, then fresh_geometry unchanged
pools.identity_check: the rebuilt pool payload_fingerprint is compared with the recorded one (run-v2/replication/<id>-<seed>.json for canonical datasets, addendum/v1/report/replication/E1-<id>-<seed>.json for new datasets); a mismatch is recorded and reported, and the rebuilt pool is used for every method so that all comparisons share one environment

methods.existing_comparators: Study.external unchanged: REAL_TRAIN (TRTR, both classifiers), CLASS_WEIGHTED_LR (logistic only), RandomOverSampler+b and SMOTE+b or SMOTENC+b (HYBRID_MINORITY, random_state = split seed as in run-v2)
methods.existing_curator_note: random curators use the split seed; all curators scored on TSTR (recorded unavailable, one-class pool) and HYBRID_MINORITY via Study.score, as in run-v2 and addendum v1

methods.SMOTE-ENN: imblearn.combine.SMOTEENN(smote=SMOTE(k_neighbors=k, random_state=42), random_state=42); default EditedNearestNeighbours cleaning (Batista et al. 2004)
methods.SMOTE-Tomek: imblearn.combine.SMOTETomek(smote=SMOTE(k_neighbors=k, random_state=42), random_state=42); default TomekLinks cleaning (Batista et al. 2004)
methods.Borderline-SMOTE: imblearn.over_sampling.BorderlineSMOTE(kind='borderline-1', k_neighbors=k, m_neighbors=10 default, random_state=42) (Han et al. 2005)

published_oversamplers.nominal_datasets: SMOTE-ENN and SMOTE-Tomek use SMOTENC(categorical_features=declared nominal columns, k_neighbors=k, random_state=42) as the oversampling step; any library exception is recorded as unavailable with its message. Borderline-SMOTE and ADASYN: unavailable, NO_NOMINAL_PATH_IN_IMBALANCED_LEARN

settings.full: sampling_strategy='auto' (minority resampled to the majority count before any cleaning)
settings.+b: sampling_strategy={positive: n_train_minority + b} (b as for the dataset and split); cleaning methods may then remove rows of either class

published_oversamplers.scaling: numerical columns scaled by a TRAIN StandardScaler before resampling and inverse-transformed after, exactly as the existing generate(); output never rounded; retained original rows carry floating round-trip error of order 1e-15
published_oversamplers.training_population: the sampler output (cleaned real TRAIN plus generated minority rows). Rows use regime label TRTR with category 'published-oversampler'; the final training class counts are recorded in training_class_counts
published_oversamplers.failure: any sampler exception (for example ADASYN with no majority neighbours) is recorded as unavailable with its message; a sampler that generates zero rows is scored and flagged generated_minority_net = 0

reimplemented_curators.label: re-implementation of the principle, not the authors' code
reimplemented_curators.input_pool: structurally complete candidates of the split's 4b pool (fresh_geometry 'schema' pool)
reimplemented_curators.budget: b; fewer eligible candidates than b is MATCHED_BUDGET_SHORTFALL/unavailable
reimplemented_curators.encoding: one-hot encoding of declared nominal columns fitted on real TRAIN (handle_unknown='ignore'); numerical columns passed through unscaled

CLLM-style.model: sklearn GradientBoostingClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42), other parameters default, fitted on real TRAIN (both classes) only
CLLM-style.scores: p = probability of the candidate's assigned class (positive) at each checkpoint; confidence = mean p; aleatoric = mean p(1-p)
CLLM-style.selection: keep candidates with aleatoric <= pool median; rank kept by confidence descending (ties by pool ordinal); take top b; if fewer than b are kept, fill from the rest by confidence descending and record the fill count

discriminator-realism.reference: realism component of RUBRIC (Yu et al. 2026) and sample-level auditing (Alaa et al., ICML 2022)
discriminator-realism.model: sklearn RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=42), other parameters default
discriminator-realism.data: real TRAIN minority rows labelled 1, pool candidates labelled 0
discriminator-realism.scores: 5-fold out-of-fold probability of label 1 (StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42), cross_val_predict method='predict_proba') for each pool candidate
discriminator-realism.selection: top b pool candidates by probability descending (ties by pool ordinal)

reimplemented_curators.scoring: TSTR and HYBRID_MINORITY via Study.score, as for the existing curators; geometry (coverage, redundancy) measured with the existing metrics()

reporting.pairwise: per dataset and classifier: quality-coverage (combined/quality-coverage, HYBRID_MINORITY) minus each new method, mean and sample SD over paired splits of the per-split difference, for F1 and AP, with exact win/tie/loss counts; existing key comparators (combined/random, combined/farthest-first, REAL_TRAIN) reported the same way
reporting.method_availability: a method is available on a dataset for ranking only if all five splits are status ok; dataset-level value = mean over the five splits

rankings.R1_curators: eight curators (six existing plus CLLM-style and discriminator-realism) over every dataset where all eight are available
rankings.R2_all: combined/quality-coverage, combined/random, combined/farthest-first, CLLM-style, discriminator-realism, REAL_TRAIN, RandomOverSampler+b, SMOTE+b (SMOTENC+b on nominal datasets), and the eight published oversampler settings, over every dataset where all sixteen are available (complete case)
rankings.rank_rule: per dataset, classifier and metric, rank 1 = highest mean; ties receive average ranks (scipy.stats.rankdata on negated values); average over datasets
rankings.excluded: CLASS_WEIGHTED_LR is logistic-only and is reported but not ranked

reporting.tests: per ranking, classifier and metric: scipy.stats.friedmanchisquare across methods with datasets as blocks; per method: scipy.stats.wilcoxon of dataset-level quality-coverage minus method differences over datasets where both are available (two-sided, zero_method='wilcox', method='auto'). Exploratory, no multiplicity adjustment, no significance claim.

literature_sanity_check.source: Newaz and Haq, arXiv 2208.09619, Table 7 (ROC-AUC %, random forest, 10-fold stratified cross-validation), read from the arXiv PDF on 2026-10-29
literature_sanity_check.ours: five-split mean AUROC x 100 for REAL_TRAIN, SMOTE+b (SMOTENC+b on nominal), ADASYN/full, SMOTE-ENN/full and SMOTE-Tomek/full, random forest (closest classifier) and logistic regression
literature_sanity_check.judgement: context only, different protocol; report whether the sign of (SMOTE minus unsampled) agrees with theirs per dataset, nothing more

reporting.reproduction_checks: re-scored existing comparators and curators compared with addendum v1 E1 rows (same environment) and run-v2 Track B rows (cross-platform); maximum absolute metric differences reported

outputs.local_only: generation/, predictions/, replication/ evidence (gitignored, hashed in manifest.json)
outputs.tables: addendum/v2/report/tables/: benchmark-curators.tex, benchmark-oversamplers.tex, benchmark-ranks.tex, addendum-datasets.tex, generated by script from saved results; captions start 'Exploratory addendum, declared after the main study'
outputs.ieee_draft: sections/04b-addendum.tex with only a \subsection{Exploratory addendum} heading, \input lines and '% AUTHORS: write the paragraph here' comments; no paper prose; BibTeX for cited methods verified against DOI/arXiv; the PDF is not built here (authors format and build)
